candidates.summary: chromeShot's filepath.Abs(dst) block is 4 lines that change nothing: Chrome inherits the Go process cwd, so a relative --screenshot= resolves the same way os.Stat(dst) does
candidates.failure_scenario: Nothing in misc/gnopreview calls os.Chdir or sets cmd.Dir, so the browser's cwd is the Go process's. filepath.Abs then only Cleans the path, and its error branch fires only when os.Getwd fails, at which point the caller's os.MkdirAll has already failed.
